description: EEG Windkraftanlagen is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Land Rheinland-Pfalz. Für die Meldung nach Erneuerbare-Energien-Gesetz (EEG) aufbereitete Standorte der Windkraftanlagen aus dem Raumordnungskataster (ROK25). Es handelt sich um geplante und bestehende Anlagen. Zusätzlich sind ehemalige (historische) Anlagen enthalten. Coverage: Land Rheinland-Pfalz. The portal files it under the publisher Land Rheinland-Pfalz. Its tags are eeg, erneuerbare-energie, erneuerbare-energien-gesetz, landesplanung, raumordnungskataster. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
